packwiz_ard.configuration.title: PackWiz-ard Configuration
packwiz_ard.configuration.common.tooltip: These settings are shared between the client and server. They can be overridden by the server if the server is running.
packwiz_ard.configuration.pack_toml.tool: This is the link to the pack.toml file for this resource pack. It is used by Packwiz to determine the version of the resource pack and to download it.
packwiz_ard.configuration.server.tooltip: These settings are specific to the server. They can be overridden by the server if the server is running.
packwiz_ard.configuration.autoUpdate.too: Enable or disable automatic updates for the resource pack.
packwiz_ard.configuration.autoUpdateInte: Set the interval for automatic updates.
packwiz_ard.configuration.minimumPermiss: Set the minimum permission level required to change these settings.
packwiz_ard.configuration.enabled.toolti: Enable or disable the Discord webhook.
packwiz_ard.configuration.webhookUrl.too: The URL of the Discord webhook.
packwiz_ard.configuration.discordAuthorN: The name of the author for Discord messages.

packwiz_ard.configuration.webhookMessage: Configure the messages sent by the Discord webhook.
